1717: build_attribute({atom,Aa,Attr}, Val) ->
1718:     case Val of
1719: 	[Expr0] ->
1720: 	    Expr = attribute_farity(Expr0),
1721: 	    {attribute,Aa,Attr,term(Expr)};
1722: 	[_,Other|_] -> ret_abstr_err(Other, "bad attribute")
1723:     end.

1725: var_list({cons,_Ac,{var,_,V},Tail}) ->
1726:     [V|var_list(Tail)];
1727: var_list({nil,_An}) -> [];
1728: var_list(Other) ->
1729:     ret_abstr_err(Other, "bad variable list").

1731: attribute_farity({cons,A,H,T}) ->
1732:     {cons,A,attribute_farity(H),attribute_farity(T)};
1733: attribute_farity({tuple,A,Args0}) ->
1734:     Args = attribute_farity_list(Args0),
1735:     {tuple,A,Args};
1736: attribute_farity({map,A,Args0}) ->
1737:     Args = attribute_farity_map(Args0),
1738:     {map,A,Args};
1739: attribute_farity({op,A,'/',{atom,_,_}=Name,{integer,_,_}=Arity}) ->
1740:     {tuple,A,[Name,Arity]};
1741: attribute_farity(Other) -> Other.

1859: check_nifs(Forms, St0) ->
1860:     FAsAnno = [{FA,Anno} || {attribute, Anno, nifs, Args} <- Forms,
1861:                             FA <- Args],
1862:     St1 = case {FAsAnno, St0#lint.load_nif} of
1863:               {[{_,Anno1}|_], false} ->
1864:                   add_warning(Anno1, no_load_nif, St0);
1865:               _ ->
1866:                   St0
1867:           end,
1868:     DefFunctions = gb_sets:subtract(St1#lint.defined, gb_sets:from_list(pseudolocals())),
1869:     Bad = [{FA,Anno} || {FA,Anno} <- FAsAnno, not gb_sets:is_element(FA, DefFunctions)],
1870:     DefFunctions1 = gb_sets:to_list(DefFunctions),
1871:     func_location_error(undefined_nif, Bad, St1, DefFunctions1).

1905: func_location_error(Type, [{{Name, Arity}=F,Anno}|Fs], St0, FAList) ->
1906:     PossibleAs = lists:sort([A || {FName, A} <:- FAList, FName =:= Name]),
1907:     case PossibleAs of
1908:         [] ->
1909:             PossibleFs = [atom_to_list(Func) ||
1910:                              {Func, A} <:- FAList, A =:= Arity],
1911:             St1 = case most_possible_string(Name, PossibleFs) of
1912:                       [] ->
1913:                           add_error(Anno, {Type,F}, St0);
1914:                       GuessF ->
1915:                           add_error(Anno, {Type,F,{GuessF,[Arity]}}, St0)
1916:                   end,
1917:             func_location_error(Type, Fs, St1, FAList);
1918:         _ ->
1919:             St1 = add_error(Anno, {Type,F,{Name,PossibleAs}}, St0),
1920:             func_location_error(Type, Fs, St1, FAList)
1921:     end;
1922: func_location_error(Type, [{F,Anno}|Fs], St0, FAList) ->
1923:     St1 = add_error(Anno, {invalid_fa_attribute,F}, St0),
1924:     func_location_error(Type, Fs, St1, FAList);
1925: func_location_error(_, [], St, _) ->
1926:     St.

244: form({attribute,_,nifs,Ns}, #imodule{nifs=Nifs0}=Module, _Opts) ->
245:     Nifs1 = case Nifs0 of
246:                 none ->
247:                     sets:new();
248:                 _ ->
249:                     Nifs0
250:             end,
251:     Nifs = sets:union(sets:from_list(Ns, [{version,2}]), Nifs1),
252:     Module#imodule{nifs=Nifs};
253: form({attribute,_,_,_}=F, #imodule{attrs=As}=Module, _Opts) ->
254:     Module#imodule{attrs=[attribute(F)|As]};
